name: Jeska
description: Realized she had to absorb the wurms back into herself, becoming Phage again.

description_citations.text: "Wurm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser rescues Multani from the Yavimayan rift and Jeska seals it with Radha's spark, which burns out.
timeline.quote: Radha's spark burned out, causing the warlord to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfir rift is sealed, forever losing Zhalfir from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: sealing the rift closed the nation off from being able to return

citation.text: "Rift", section "Zhalfirin rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out most of Suq'Ata's territories during the Phyrexian Invasion; they are lost forever after Jeska closes the rift.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion Teferi planeswalker phased out most of Suq'Ata's territorities.

citation.text: "Suq'Ata", section "Partially phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Leshrac's influence, Jeska uses Radha to seal the rift, costing Radha her potential to become a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Under the influence of Leshrac , Jeska used Radha to seal the rift, causing the warrior to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska, manipulated by Leshrac, forcefully closes the Zhalfirin rift, and the phased lands are lost to oblivion.
timeline.quote: the phased lands of Zhalfir were lost seemingly forever, cast into oblivion

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska asks Radha for help, Radha refuses, and Jeska wins their fight using her latent Phage powers.
timeline.quote: Radha refused, and the two barbarian women fought.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska takes the tethered Radha to Zhalfir and uses her to channel mana and close the rift, greatly weakening her.
timeline.quote: Radha was greatly weakened by this act.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani bonds Radha to Yavimaya, restoring her green mana, and Jeska uses her to close the Yavimaya rift.
timeline.quote: Jeska then used Radha again to close the rift in Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha and Venser accompany Jeska to the Otarian rift, where Jeska's final act closes all rifts.
timeline.quote: Jeska's final act closed the Otarian rift, as well as all others.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor travels with Jeska to Cabal City to find Kamahl and fights in the pits, without success.
timeline.quote: briefly fighting in the pits alongside her

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor opposes Kamahl when the Mirari drives him to take over all the tribes; Jeska is mortally wounded and Kamahl comes to his senses.
timeline.quote: Following Jeska's mortal wounding, Kamahl snapped out of the Mirari's influence

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska returns to Otaria and sees the caved-in dome.
timeline.quote: the arena's dome had long since caved in

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer loses his right arm to Jeska's explosive bolt in the pits and receives a golem arm paid for by Skellum.
timeline.quote: where he lost his right arm when he was hit by one of Jeska’s explosive bolts

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Caster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under the Mirari's influence Kamahl goes berserk, slaying most of his kin and dealing Jeska a horrific blow.
timeline.quote: Kamahl lost control and went berserk, slaying most of his kin and striking a horrific blow against Jeska

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Barbarian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids captures the dying Jeska and brings her to the Cabal Patriarch.
timeline.quote: she ultimately was captured by Braids and brought to the Cabal Patriarch

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Barbarian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Patriarch's attempt to destroy Jeska instead gives birth to Phage the Untouchable.
timeline.quote: attempt to destroy Jeska instead gave birth to Phage the Untouchable

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor's dream magic sends the deathwurms out of Phage, leaving her Jeska again.
timeline.quote: those deathwurms were sent out into the world, leaving her once again Jeska

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: To save the land Jeska pulls the deathwurms back into herself, damning herself to life as Phage.
timeline.quote: she pulled them back into herself, damning herself to a life as Phage

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Phage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl attaches the Mirari to his sword and tries to unite the Pardic barbarians by force.
timeline.quote: He attached it to the pommel of his sword and tried to use its power to unite the Pardic barbarians under his rule.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl mortally wounds his sister Jeska with the Mirari-enhanced sword.
timeline.quote: he used his Mirari-enhanced sword to mortally wound Jeska

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl leaves the Pardic Mountains and his sister Jeska to make a name for himself, drawn by the Mirari.
timeline.quote: In leaving behind the Pardic Mountains, where age-old territorial skirmishes between the barbarians and dwarves continue to rage on, Kamahl leaves his sister Jeska

citation.text: "Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the Otarian rift closed by Jeska, the Great Mending begins.
timeline.quote: With the last major rift sealed, the Great Mending began.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids kills Seton and kidnaps Jeska for the Patriarch.
timeline.quote: She then killed the centaur and kidnapped Jeska

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska says she and Kamahl both come from Balthor's forge.
timeline.quote: My brother and I both come from Balthor's forge.

citation.text: Jeska, Warrior Adept (Judgment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Braids helps Phage and Kuberr survive an assassination attempt and kills the Cabal Patriarch with a nightmare beast.
timeline.quote: she killed the Cabal Patriarch instead with one of her nightmare beasts

citation.text: "Braids", section "Succumbing to Dementia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus and Eesha try to obtain the Mirari while Jeska and Balthor try to separate it from Kamahl for fear of its corrupting influence.
timeline.quote: attempt to obtain the potent orb for themselves

citation.text: "Judgment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under the Mirari's influence Kamahl unites the tribes, defeats the Elite Eight with excessive power and plunges the tribes into civil war.
timeline.quote: he proclaims himself champion; many, however, refuse his rule because he has gone mad with power, plunging the tribes into civil war.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska and Balthor decide to steal the Mirari; Jeska knocks Balthor out and fights Kamahl, who strikes her after a false report that she killed Balthor.
timeline.quote: Balthor arrives to clear the misunderstanding, and Kamahl realizes his tragic mistake.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cabal troops attack the village; the barbarians unite and win, and Kamahl resolves to bring the surviving Jeska to Seton, with Balthor carrying the Mirari sword.
timeline.quote: Kamahl resolves to bring her to his friend Seton , deep in the Krosan forest, to cure her.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Seton agrees to cure Jeska and sends Kamahl to Thriss, who helps him control his strength and desires and commune with nature.
timeline.quote: gives him substantial help in controlling his strength and desires and makes him able to communicate with nature.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl returns home, is dominated by the Mirari and tries to take all the tribes under his dictatorship, dividing the barbarians.
timeline.quote: Initially, he was content simply to return home covered in glory, but inevitably, the Mirari dominated his mind.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl and the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In battle Kamahl impales Jeska with the Mirari-sword, leaving an incurable wound; shocked, he resolves to be rid of the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Kamahl viciously impaling Jeska with his Mirari-sword

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl and the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Attacked at the edge of the Krosan forest, Balthor sacrifices himself so Kamahl can flee with Jeska; Seton guides Kamahl in and Thriss teaches him druidism.
timeline.quote: Balthor chose to sacrifice himself to let Kamahl flee with Jeska.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids kidnaps Jeska, and the Cabal Patriarch turns her into Phage; Kamahl and Phage fight until Akroma interrupts and they defeat her together.
timeline.quote: who tried to kill her, but instead turned her into Phage

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona is betrayed and killed by her minions Sash and Waistcoat, releasing Jeska, who becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: killing Karona and releasing Jeska, who then became a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage drains her victims' energy and a faint memory of Jeska stirs before she is lost again.
timeline.quote: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred.

citation.text: Syphon Soul (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Deathwurms are purged from Phage, but Kamahl must watch his sister become Phage again to bind them.
timeline.quote: was forced to watch his sister become Phage once again.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cabal healing magic transforms Jeska into Phage, a pit fighter whose touch brings death.
timeline.quote: Kamahl's sister Jeska is transformed by foul Cabal healing magic, into Phage

citation.text: "Onslaught", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids takes Jeska from Seton's hut and kills Seton; Kamahl finds the hut burned and his sister missing.
timeline.quote: Seton opposed this, and the dementist killed him.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixidor's spark makes nightmares real; Phage expels deathwurms and is Jeska again.
timeline.quote: she is Jeska once again, and she exchanges a few tender words with her brother.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska absorbs the wurms back and becomes Phage again, despising Kamahl.
timeline.quote: she returns to being Phage and once again despises the druid

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska decides to absorb the wurms back into herself, even though it means becoming Phage again.
timeline.quote: realized that she had to absorb them back in herself, even though that meant she would become Phage again

citation.text: "Wurm", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl swings the Soul Reaper in Sanctum, killing Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, whose merged souls become Karona.
timeline.quote: the axe claimed Phage and Akroma's lives, as well as an unexpected third life

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl frees his sister Jeska from Karona and Phage.
timeline.quote: Kamahl frees his sister, Jeska , from both Karona and Phage

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn returns to Otaria to take Jeska to Argentum.
timeline.quote: Karn returns to Otaria, Dominaria, to take her to Argentum

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn tells Jeska she is a planeswalker and asks her to travel the multiverse with him.
timeline.quote: Karn intimates that Jeska is a planeswalker and beseeches her to travel the multiverse as his companion.

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn shows Jeska Memnarch, the golem he forged from the Mirari.
timeline.quote: until Karn informs and shows her Memnarch

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn leaves Argentum to train Jeska, granting his warden the Mirari orb and stewardship of the plane.
timeline.quote: The second was stewardship over the plane itself.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Warden". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn reshapes the Mirari into the sentient Memnarch, protector of Argentum.
timeline.quote: Karn reshaped the Mirari as a sentient being

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn and Jeska drop the Mirari on Argentum, where it becomes the Warden, explores, and renames the plane Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: An idea pops into his head to rename his new vision of the plane after himself: Mirrodin.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Argentum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the Zhalfir rift, removing part of Jamuraa from the multiverse.
timeline.quote: removing the phased-out portion of Jamuraa from the multiverse

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska closes the Otarian rift and dies, causing the Mending.
timeline.quote: Jeska finally closed the most massive rift over Otaria

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Karona is killed the three women separate and Jeska's spark ignites, making her a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: the three women separated

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the temporal crisis Jeska appears on Dominaria searching for Karn.
timeline.quote: Jeska appeared on Dominaria while searching for Karn

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska falls under the mental control of Leshrac, who hopes to use her Phage powers against Bolas.
timeline.quote: unknowingly fell under the mental control of the insidious Leshrac

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Keld Jeska defeats Radha and takes her to use as a mana lens.
timeline.quote: she defeated and took Radha to use her as a mana lens for closing the rifts

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Zhalfir Jeska closes the rift without consulting Teferi, causing the loss of the phased-out lands.
timeline.quote: she closed the local rift without consulting Teferi, causing the irrevocable loss of the phased-out lands

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Yavimaya a vision from Leshrac makes Jeska immolate Multani's physical form, and she then closes the rift.
timeline.quote: caused Jeska to break the connection and immolate

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Madara Leshrac ambushes Jeska, strips her Phage legacy and encases her in stone when she refuses to fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Leshrac encased her in stone to keep her from interfering

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas frees Jeska and tells her the Otarian rift cannot be closed.
timeline.quote: Bolas freed Jeska but assured her that the Otarian rift could not be closed

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska, Venser and Radha teleport into the heart of the Otarian rift.
timeline.quote: Jeska and the two planeswalkers teleported into the heart of the rift

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska shatters the image of Karona and closes all rifts in one discharge, allowing the Great Mending to begin.
timeline.quote: In one huge discharge of her power, she closed them all, allowing the Great Mending to begin.

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska appears in a white void and is welcomed by her dead brother Kamahl, welcoming oblivion.
timeline.quote: she was welcomed by her beloved long-dead brother Kamahl

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Much later Jeska closes the rift in Otaria's skies, and the dead Kamahl welcomes her in a white void.
timeline.quote: Jeska sacrificed herself to close the rift in Otaria's skies, allowing the Great Mending to begin.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac takes over Jeska's mind and uses her and Radha to close the rifts in Yavimaya and Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Leshrac managed to get hold of Jeska's mind

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Madaran rift Leshrac strips Jeska of Phage's powers and attacks Nicol Bolas, paralyzing him and rotting his body.
timeline.quote: Leshrac and Bolas battled both by spells and claw

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani bonds Radha to the forest, restoring her green mana, and hypnotizes Jeska.
timeline.quote: He also created a new bond between Radha and the forest

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska awakens and blasts Multani's physical body to smithereens, then uses Radha and his mask to seal the rift, diminishing his essence.
timeline.quote: Jeska awakened and blasted Multani's physical body to smithereens.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Legendary planeswalkers sacrifice their sparks or lives to close the rifts.
timeline.quote: to sacrifice their sparks or lives to close the rifts

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "The Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska's final sacrifice closes the last rift, catalyzing the Great Mending; planeswalkers become mortal mages.
timeline.quote: Jeska’s final sacrifice closed the last rift, catalyzing the multiversal Great Mending .

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "The Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska uses part of Radha's soul to close the Zhalfir rift, severing Zhalfir from the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: severing Zhalfir from the Multiverse entirely

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska burns out Radha's inherited spark, closing the Yavimaya rift but temporarily destroying Multani.
timeline.quote: burning out the spark Radha had unknowingly inherited

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the rift at the heart of Otaria, consuming her entirely and unleashing the Great Mending.
timeline.quote: The effort consumed her entirely.

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn turns the Mirari into Memnarch.
timeline.quote: Karn turns the Mirari into Memnarch

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska gives her life to close the final rift over Otaria.
timeline.quote: Jeska gives her life to close the final rift over Otaria.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Temporal crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska studies the rifts, uses Radha as her tool, and is stopped by Venser and company at great cost to Radha's spark and Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: only after grievous damage had been done to Radha's spark and Zhalfir

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska casts Venser and Radha back and sacrifices herself, and the Mending takes place.
timeline.quote: with that final sacrifice, the Mending took place

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska arrives in Urborg and asks where her mentor Karn is.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker protégé of Karn asks where her mentor is.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska returns to Dominaria seeking vengeance for Karn as Leshrac returns.
timeline.quote: Her friend and ally Karn is gone, and someone will pay.

citation.text: "Future Sight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the time rift before Zhalfir can be phased back in, effectively erasing it from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Jeska Planeswalker sealed the rift before Zhalfir could be phased back in

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska questions Jhoira, Venser and Teferi, then goes to Otaria where Leshrac proposes using Venser's and Radha's sparks to close the rifts.
timeline.quote: Leshrac proposes that Jeska use Venser's and Radha ’s latent planeswalker sparks to channel mana and close them

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska defeats Radha in a duel at Keld and takes her unconscious.
timeline.quote: Jeska defeats Radha in a duel and takes the unconscious elf with her.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska uses Radha as a buffer to seal the Zhalfirin rift, leaving Radha near death and Zhalfir lost.
timeline.quote: Jeska is past the point of no return and completes the sealing, leaving Radha close to death.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the Yavimayan rift through Radha and Multani's mask, leaving the mask inert; Jhoira buries it.
timeline.quote: Jhoira buries Multani's mask in the hopes that he can someday be revived

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac reveals he had been influencing Jeska, paralyzes her and drains her black mana with the mask.
timeline.quote: Leshrac paralyzes her and uses the mask of the Myojin of Night’s Reach to drain Jeska’s black mana and corrosive touch from her time as Phage .

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas restores Jeska, uses Leshrac's trapped essence to close the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac, and departs Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Bolas then uses Leshrac’s trapped essence to feed and close it, killing the defeated planeswalker.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska sacrifices herself to seal the last rift over Otaria, and the Mending alters the planeswalker spark.
